body.x: The Gyeonggido Business & Science Accelerator (GBSA) will participate in CES 2025, the world’s largest technology exhibition, held in Las Vegas from January 7 to 10 (local time). GBSA aims to showcase the advanced technologies of Gyeonggi-do’s companies on a global stage.

This year’s CES is themed "DIVE IN," focusing on innovative solutions that transform daily life. CES 2025 brings together global technology leaders, innovators, media, and government officials to discuss and experience the future, showcasing groundbreaking technologies and products across various industries.

GBSA has organized a joint pavilion with 17 companies, spotlighting Gyeonggi-do’s technological prowess in semiconductors, biotech, digital health, and advanced mobility. TMEV Net and VHEX Lab have received CES Innovation Awards, underscoring their recognition in the global market.

Established in 2022, TMEV Net developed a groundbreaking cable cooling system for megawatt charging in electric vehicles. Their CES award-winning charging cable utilizes liquid-phase change cooling technology, addressing conventional rapid charging cables’ weight and overheating challenges. This solution is a next-generation technology ideal for charging large vehicles, ships, and urban air mobility (UAM).

Founded in 2023, VHEX Lab specializes in XR-AI-VH-based psychological evaluation, counseling, and therapy solutions. Their innovative mental health management tools include 'EmpathyVR,' an empathetic diagnostic service, and 'SITh (Self-Insight Therapy), a Gestalt psychology-based therapy program.

Other notable participants include CHAEWOORA INC., which showcases automated signage solutions using 3D printing technology; CREFLE Inc., which offers smart factory vision solutions; and Itchy Inc., which develops digital healthcare apps for managing musculoskeletal disorders.
Through its participation in CES 2025, GBSA seeks to enhance the global competitiveness of Gyeonggi-do companies and strengthen the province’s status as a hub for cutting-edge technology industries.

The 17 companies featured in the CES 2025 GBSA joint pavilion are TMEV net, VHEX Lab, CHAEWOORA INC., CREFLE Inc., Creple.co., Ltd., Dronetree (DRT), IDEA CO., LTD., itphy Inc., LAXPPY Inc., MAMT, MetroAir, Neurosense Co., Ltd., Parandurume Inc., READYCURE Inc., SCIST CO., LTD, SUNGHO ATEC Agricultural Corporation Co., Ltd., and WITHFORCE Inc.
